rows.note: Use 學院 as the all-purpose term when the academy is an educational institution or specialized training school.

example.english: This academy specializes in training pilots.
example.traditional: 呢間學院專門培訓飛機師。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 hok6 jyun2 zyun1 mun4 pui4 fan3 fei1 gei1 si1

rows.note: Use 學會 when the academy is an organized learned society devoted to a field of study or the arts.

example.english: The Hong Kong Astronomical Academy holds public lectures every year.
example.traditional: 香港天文學會每年都舉辦公開講座。
example.jyutping: hoeng1 gong2 tin1 man4 hok6 wui6 mui5 nin4 dou1 geoi2 baan6 gung1 hoi1 gong2 zo6
